1.consolidated_definition: Coger de chata o de mingo. “A la canalla te entrego —pa que te cojan de chota.” Rafael Santiago, No me crea tan pasmao, 1933.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To be handed over to the rabble or the common people. "I'll turn you in to the rabble – so they can catch you," Rafael Santiago, No me crea tan pasmao, 1933.
